name: gamma-aminobutyric acid type A receptor subunit alpha6

function.text: GABRA6 encodes gamma-aminobutyric acid receptor subunit alpha-6 receptor subunit alpha-6). Annotated molecular activities include GABA-A receptor activity and benzodiazepine receptor activity. It participates in signal transduction and chloride transmembrane transport.
